slots.title: Atlas
slots.shows: Index card (5 s), then the hook: it remembers, it watches, nothing leaves the box. Index card again at 0:55.
slots.line: This is Atlas: a private AI box that sees, remembers, talks and learns. Your video never leaves it.
watchers: Best Overall / Best AI / Best Embedded

slots.title: It runs your day
slots.shows: Knows your week (Canvas, calendar), the Day loop plan, one approval card.
slots.line: Point it at your week: it reads your Canvas and calendar, plans the day around what the cameras see, and asks before it acts.
watchers: Best Overall / Best AI / Best Embedded

slots.title: It learns
slots.shows: The big Qwen teaches the small Qwen; before/after scores; our adapter on Hugging Face; quick unplug.
slots.line: When it needs a new skill, a big open model teaches the small one on the box.
watchers: Best Overall / Best AI / Best Embedded

slots.title: The learning lab
slots.shows: Qwen3.8-27B teacher on R9700 A, LoRA on R9700 B, ROCm, loss curve, publishing to the Hub.
slots.line: Here is where that teaching happens: two AMD Radeon R9700s on ROCm.

slots.title: Box and lab
slots.shows: The Q4_K_M package hot-swapped onto the Jetson; watts from amd-smi and tegrastats; joules per answer.
slots.line: The lesson comes back as a smaller, smarter model, hot-swapped on the Jetson. We measure every joule both ways.

slots.title: On the Jetson
slots.shows: Cameras and face blur; the on-device Qwen VL understands the scene; FPS and tok/s; then unplug the internet.
slots.line: Everything you see live runs on this Jetson, with the internet unplugged.

slots.title: Data into counts
slots.shows: Frames to events to episodes; Waste Watch counting items and the bin zone they end in.
slots.line: The same cameras turn a room into data: events, episodes and counts.

slots.title: Impact, shared
slots.shows: Diversion rate before vs after nudges; the leaderboard served from Neon.
slots.line: Point it at a recycling bin, and a campus can measure what changed.

slots.title: Friends' Atlases
slots.shows: Two Atlases agree on a time through Neon; the event lands in the Day Run plan; the League.
slots.line: Point it at your friends: Atlases agree on a time through Neon, and only free or busy leaves each box.

slots.title: Day Run
slots.shows: A bad plan fails, a good plan wins three stars, hard mode re-routes, Play mode, a Sort It round started by a face.
slots.line: Point it at your habits: play tomorrow before you live it.
